reviewStatus: DRAFT: not yet approved by the reviewer
reviewNotes: DRAFT for reviewer: needHelp.home was "Back". It always returns to Home, so "Home" is the honest label.
DRAFT for reviewer: needHelp.call and needHelp.callHint are new spoken labels for screen readers on number buttons.
DRAFT for reviewer: talkToSomeone.needHelpNow was "I need help now". It now matches the Need help now pill.
Question for reviewer: should Message be the main action instead of Call? Typing may feel safer for a lonely student.
DRAFT for reviewer: talkToSomeone.pending was "Number pending verification". Plainer, and it is also what screen readers say on each disabled button.

DRAFT for reviewer: talkToSomeone.pendingWhatNow is new and only shows while no contact number is checked. Each card already says the number is being checked, so this line only says what to do in danger (no number). Please confirm this guidance.
DRAFT for reviewer: talkToSomeone.openFailed is one full sentence with {number} in it (used on S8 and S9). Keep {number} when editing.
DRAFT for reviewer: needHelpButton.hint was "Opens a screen with who to reach right now", which is not true while numbers are pending.
Note for reviewer: Need help now still says "once our reviewer has checked them"; consider the same "we are still checking" wording there.
DRAFT for reviewer: talkToSomeone.noContacts is new. It shows only if the contacts list is empty.
For whoever edits contacts: write "verified": true with no quotes, and the phone number in quotes, e.g. "phone": "<number as given by the person>". Anything else keeps the number pending.
Note for reviewer: the top note already says these people are not emergency services, so a contact's cannotHelpWith can name something more specific than "Emergencies".
DRAFT for reviewer: welcome.ageQuestion is new; the guide gives the two button labels but not the question.

DRAFT for reviewer: welcome.title was "Welcome to Steady" and welcome.body was "Support for adult students. No account. Everything stays on your phone." The promise now leads. To go back, restore both.
DRAFT for reviewer: welcome.inDanger is new, matching talkToSomeone.pendingWhatNow (no number). Please confirm this guidance.
DRAFT for reviewer: welcome.answerStays is new. Only the 18+ answer leaves a trace (one flag), and it never leaves the phone, so avoid saying "we do not save your answer".

Placeholder for reviewer: breathing timings (4 in, 4 hold, 6 out, 4 cycles) are the guide placeholder until the calming-tool sample arrives. Each phase has a motion (grow, hold or shrink) that drives the circle; edit label and seconds freely.
For whoever edits finished.options: next must be "home" or "talkToSomeone". The order of options does not matter.
DRAFT for reviewer: breathing.intro is new and shows under the Breathing title.
For whoever edits breathing.progress: keep {current} and {total}; it shows which round of breathing someone is on, e.g. "2 of 4".
DRAFT for reviewer: finished.message is new and shows above "How do you feel now?". Leave it empty to show only the question.
DRAFT for reviewer: each finished option can have a hint, read out by screen readers only, saying where the answer leads.

DRAFT for reviewer: adultsOnly.inDanger is new and shows on the under-18 screen, which has no Need help button. It matches welcome.inDanger; keep it text only, with no numbers unless they are verified.
